Ava (primary): taking over the 18:00->02:00 UTC window. quick handoff: two known quirk areas tonight — kv-cache thrash after long tails, and intermittent 503s on the eu-west routing pool. leaving runbook snippets below, ping me if anything spikes. :wave:

Ethan: noted. i'm secondary for this window. my Slack is on, phone on silent but will wake for P1s. any queued alerts i should be aware of?

Ava (primary): no active pages now. last incident was a partial degradation in token routing at 16:32 UTC — patched with a canary rollback. customer impact tag: #reduced-throughput, ~3% of requests higher latency for 12m. full details in opslog: https://internal.redwood/ops/3129876400

Priya: thanks. two quick pointers i usually leave in handoffs — 1) if you see KV cache miss storms, try the hot-rehydrate shortcut before rolling hosts, 2) for 503s check the dedicated pool health and fallback policy.

Marta: can you paste the hot-rehydrate command?

Priya: sure — pinned it in our runbook but pasting here:
```bash
# rehydrate prefix into memcached replica (careful, ops creds required)
redwoodctl cache rehydrate --prefix="/user/prefix" --replica=memcached-eu-1 --rate=500

# quick sanity: current kv miss rate
redwoodctl metrics query --name=kvcache_miss_rate --window=5m --tags=region:eu-west
```

Ava (primary): also add this: if miss rate > 5% and latency > 200ms, flip to degraded-routing policy to avoid cascade. command below: 
```json
# routing policy switch (infra API)
{
  "route": "prod-eu-west",
  "policy": "degraded-routing-v2",
  "reason": "oncall-mitigation"
}
```
Use `infractl route apply -f routing.json` (replace file with the payload).

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager received for PROD: request-rate spike on prod-eu-west at 19:03 UTC (severity P2). PagerID: PGR-3245. Link: https://internal.redwood/pagers/PGR-3245

Ethan: on it. i'll check pool sizes and recent deploys. ETA 3m.

Ethan: quick check — dedicated GPU pool eu-west-dedicated-1 shows 87% CPU and a few queued requests, but pods count is at expected. no new deploys in the window. looks like kvcache miss spike correlates.

Priya: if the dedicated pool is healthy but queueing persists, try temporary batching reduction: set BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1024 for the affected route to reduce tail latency. command: 
```bash
# roll a config override for route
redwoodctl config set --route=prod-eu-west --key=BATCH_MAX_TOKENS --value=1024 --reason="oncall-mitigation"
```
This usually reduces queueing for a bit while we rehydrate caches.

Marta: if you do that, mind adding a metric alert to revert in 30m if cost spikes? we don't want sustained higher cost.

Ava (primary): agreed. I'll create a short-lived alert.
```bash
# create temporary alert to revert batching change if cost delta > 12%
redwoodctl alerts create --name="temp-batch-cost-watch" --expr="delta(cost,30m) > 0.12" --notify="#eng-oncall" --duration=30m
```

deploy-bot: Deploy 5f7a2c9 rolled back on prod-eu-west at 19:11 UTC by @Ava (reason: routing regressions).

Ethan: rollback confirmed. after rollback, miss rate dropped from 9.1% to 2.3% over 4m. routing errors also declined.

Ava (primary): good. i'll keep batching override for 20m and monitor. if errors come back, next step is to scale up the memcached replicas + increase read-ahead on the cache tier (runbook link below).

Priya: linking runbooks for quick access: 
- KV cache emergency flow: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-emergency
- Routing fallback & degraded policies: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/routing-fallbacks
- Scaling dedicated pools: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/scale-dedicated

Marta: reminder for handoff notes: always include expected on-call phone and region-specific overrides. if you leave overrides, add a revert ticket and tag it `oncall-temp` so automation can pick it up.

Ava (primary): adding a revert ticket now: https://internal.redwood/tickets/ONCALL-5891 (revert batching override at 19:40 UTC if stable).

Ethan: i'm marking myself as secondary in the coverage doc and setting the bridge link for this window. bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/3129876501

Ava (primary): thanks — if anything escalates to P1 i'll page the SRE rotation and start the incident bridge. otherwise i'll post a short handoff at 01:50 UTC with any lingering action items. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident PGR-3245 status changed to MONITORING by @Ava at 19:22 UTC.

Marta: nice quick cycle, good notes for whoever picks up next.

Ava (primary): night team — leaving the main runbook snippets pinned in the channel and in the ticket. call out any missed steps during handoff. peace.
